notes: Alex de Vries (Digiconomist), quoted by BBC (1 Mar 2026), estimated the facility could consume nearly 6 billion litres (~6,000,000 m3) of freshwater per year, and noted cooling residue limits recirculation and that Scotland's cooler climate offers limited benefit. Basis/assumptions not published; this is a third-party order-of-magnitude estimate, not an applicant figure. The applicant has published no cooling technology or water demand figures; the PAN description includes a balancing pond (surface drainage).
No applicant water or cooling figures located in consultation material as of 2026-07-30.
